description:
Goal

A recursive semantic activation preserves the correlation among inputs that arrived together. Exact publisher rows remain alternatives until each row has been analyzed; no pointwise join invents Cartesian input combinations or erases an already calculated callable target.

Signal

The combined Enum.with_index mapper family still misroutes string and integer elements through the atom mapper after entry-dispatch refinement. Exact publications reach shared List.reduce_step as three correlated rows: binary list/continuation/reducer, integer list/continuation/reducer, and atom list/continuation/reducer. World::normalize_contributions and ActivationInputMap then union columns independently. The resulting Cartesian product normalizes same-function closure literals to one atom-target survivor, so semantic analysis publishes the wrong reducer target. Each isolated mapper passes; only coexistence exposes the loss.

Strategy

Replace pointwise activation-input joining with a finite canonical antichain of correlated rows. A publisher owns a replaceable set of rows because one publisher can contribute multiple recursive alternatives. Normalize and analyze each row independently. Merge only post-analysis results: entry clauses by set union, failure by OR, result types after evaluation, and exact activation contributions as rows. Permit whole-row subsumption only when every column of one row contains the corresponding column of another; never synthesize a row by joining columns. Preserve the existing incremental fixpoint: publication replacement, withdrawal, and rebase update named publisher facts, with no seal, pass, session inventory, provenance reconstruction, or downstream target selection. Expose an explicitly named joined projection only to consumers whose question is genuinely uncorrelated, after semantic decisions.

Plan

1. Pin the first loss with a production-path test proving exact incoming rows and the erroneous pointwise aggregate.
2. Introduce ActivationInputRow and ActivationInputAlternatives at the contribution authority; remove the Vec<Ty> pointwise semantic input model.
3. Define canonical alternative union, safe whole-row subsumption, publisher replacement, withdrawal, and rebase semantics.
4. Analyze alternatives independently and refine existing semantic products from their results without reconstructing callable identity.
5. Migrate RuntimeDemand and transport/ABI consumers, deleting obsolete joins and compensations rather than recreating them elsewhere.
6. Prove forward addition, waiting extension, replacement, withdrawal, reverse scheduling, stale-target retraction, no Cartesian products, and bounded convergence.

Acceptance

The combined enum_map_family oracle matches through interp, JIT, and AOT, including string, integer, and tuple mapper results. Structural tests prove correlated rows survive shared bounded recursion, no impossible cross-product row is analyzed, and replacing or withdrawing one publisher retracts its stale callable target. Resource/convergence assertions measure the new smaller invariant rather than preserving old counts. Full library, targeted fixture matrix, formatting, strict clippy, and relevant documentation pass warning-free; temporary spike fixtures are removed.
title: Preserve correlated activation input alternatives
